title: Parity target as a product of block outputs
statement: Let $m\ge 7$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^{2^m}$. For each $b\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, take the $2m$ coordinates of $x$ indexed by the two blocks specified by $b$, and let $q_b(x)\in\{-1,1\}$ be the sign-valued mod-two inner product of those blocks. Then the parity target evaluated at $x$ is $\prod_{b=0}^{m-1}q_b(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a natural number with $7\le m$
